en.html:
The stairs went on longer than expected.

A gentle slope, though. Sometimes it became a level passage. For all this walking, we should not have gone very deep.

Beyond the house above, then? Not that either. According to Muramasa, round and round only we were being taken. ...The designer's intention was not reaching me.

Neeche jaana hai. Down. A modest ambition for a staircase. Yet this one kept going sideways, as though it wished to discuss the matter before committing itself. Perhaps by the next turn the basement would come up to meet us and save everybody the trouble. I continued walking. Arguing with the architecture would not make it descend any faster.

After several minutes, at last I arrived somewhere that seemed to be a room.

Here.

Nothing I could actually see in the dark. Still, I knew. Through my skin, that simple fact had reached me.

Silver Star was here.

...No careless action. With Silver Star nearby, this was a tiger's hunting ground. At any moment those sharpened claws might come.

Quiet the mind. One step into the room.
Carefully. More carefully than that. I had to search...

茶々丸「なんか足りなかったんだ。 　やっぱ愛かな。愛なんだろーなぁ。うん」
景明「……………………」
茶々丸「さってっと。 　じゃ、おしまいにしようか」
茶々丸「お兄さんは早いとこ逃げて。 　なんとなくで言うけど、まだこの世にやり 残したことがあるんでない？」
景明「――――――」
茶々丸「ここにいると巻き添え食うからさ。 　おい、村正」
村正《……えっ？》
茶々丸「しっかりしとけよ。 　文字どーりの鋼鉄はがねの心で、仕手が平静じゃ ない時に支えてやるのも劒冑の仕事だろ？」
茶々丸「外へ引っ張っていってやれ」
村正《…………。 　あ、貴方はどうするの？》
茶々丸「ほっとけよ、かびくせぇ骨董品が。 　こっちの始末はこっちでつける」
村正《――――》
村正《貴方》
茶々丸「やかましい。 　とっとと行け」
茶々丸「正国！」
